# Kutak project instructions

- Frontend: Vue 3 single-file components, Vite, and Bootstrap 5.
- Backend: Flask JSON API in `backend/app.py`.
- Keep the interface Serbian-language, responsive, and aligned with the forest-green Kutak brand.
- Configure API URL with `VITE_API_URL`; local Flask defaults to `http://localhost:5000`.
- Reservations are demo-only in-memory data and are cleared when the Flask process restarts.
